title: Amber Alert issued for 7-year-old Alberta girl RCMP say was abducted from home
summary: RCMP have issued an Amber Alert for a 7-year-old girl who police say was abducted from her home in northwest Alberta.

image.caption: An Amber Alert has been issued for 7-year-old Aspen Wilson who RCMP say was abducted from her residence in Valleyview. (CBC)

blocks.text: RCMP have issued an Amber Alert for a 7-year-old girl who police say was abducted from her home in northwest Alberta.
Aspen Wilson was abducted from her residence in Valleyview, RCMP say
RCMP have issued an Amber Alert for a seven-year-old girl who police say was abducted from her home in northwest Alberta.
In an alert issued shortly after 10:15 a.m. MT on Monday, police said Aspen Wilson, 7, was abducted from her residence in the town of Valleyview, Alta.
RCMP said Aspen is described as 4 feet tall, slim, with curly shoulder blond hair and blue eyes.
RCMP said Aspen was taken by her stepfather Alexander Stone.
Police said Stone is 28 years old, 6 foot 5 inches, 185 lbs, with brown hair and hazel eyes.
Stone is believed to be driving a grey 2004 Chevrolet Venture van with Alberta licence plate CWY-3459, and may be possibly driving to Slave Lake or Red Deer.
